children: Onconetix plans a 1-for-10 reverse stock split on November 6, bringing its aggregate reverse split ratio to 1-for-100 and reducing outstanding shares to about 589,000.
The split is expected to take effect at 12:01 a.m. ET on November 6, 2026; ONCO will continue trading on Nasdaq under its existing symbol.
Outstanding shares are expected to fall from approximately 5.9 million to approximately 589,000, before fractional-share adjustments.
Authorized common shares remain at 250 million, and the par value remains $0.00001 per share.
No fractional shares will be issued; eligible holders will receive cash in lieu, and applicable equity awards and securities will be adjusted proportionally.
